checks.label: Perl embedding headers
checks.hint: Install the Perl development headers (libperl-dev on Ubuntu) and a C compiler.

notes: The Perl XS shim is rebuilt for your Perl installation. Install Perl development headers and a C compiler; do not reuse an XS binary from another Perl version.

checks.label: Lua 5.4 development files
checks.hint: Install Lua 5.4 headers and pkg-config, for example liblua5.4-dev on Ubuntu.

notes: Lua 5.4 and its C development headers are needed to rebuild the native shim with your compiler.
Install R with its C development headers and a C compiler (r-base-dev on Ubuntu); the kit builds the local R package.

checks.label: PHP FFI extension
checks.hint: Enable or install the PHP FFI extension. The local launcher enables FFI for this process.

checks.label: clipspy Python package
checks.hint: Activate a Python virtual environment, then run python3 -m pip install clipspy==1.0.6.

notes: CLIPS uses Python 3 and clipspy 1.0.6, installed into the Python environment you run the kit from. A standalone clips executable does not replace clipspy.
Install MiniZinc with the Gecode solver and fzn-gecode on PATH. Python 3 hosts the core; both minizinc and fzn-gecode execute locally.
Install GForth (gforth on PATH); Python 3 hosts the core binding and talks to the GForth process.
Install GNU APL 2.0 (apl on PATH); Python 3 hosts the core binding and talks to the APL process. Other APL implementations are not qualified.
Install CBQN 0.12.0 (bqn on PATH); Node hosts the core and the persistent CBQN process. Other BQN interpreters are not qualified.
Install AssemblyScript 0.28.20 (asc on PATH), for example npm install --global assemblyscript@0.28.20.

Install the wasm32-unknown-unknown Rust target, normally with rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown. No WASI runtime is needed.
